ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark gray) pixel surface with localized high-intensity (white) clusters; estimated white-to-black pixel ratio of approximately 0.12:1 across the visible fluke area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Discontinuous, high-contrast white circular and ring-shaped pixel clusters (mottling) distributed primarily across the distal regions of both lobes, with a sparse concentration in the medial region near the notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped depression at the center; the angle is approximately 65 degrees with a clear vertex.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the entire trailing edge boundary; topography includes sharp, jagged peaks and shallow, rounded valleys with varying pixel-amplitudes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edge exhibits a strong concave curve from the notch to the tips, resulting in sharp, upwardly-tapering distal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density clusters of circular white pixel formations ranging from 10 to 30 pixels in diameter, heavily concentrated on the lower-left distal tip and upper-right edge.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Short, faint, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (rake-like marks) are visible on the mid-section of the left lobe, cutting through the dark primary pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive circular rosette scarring consistent with barnacle detachment; significant irregular indentation/notch on the outer trailing edge of the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Fine, high-intensity stippling (white micro-dots) clustered immediately adjacent to the median notch.
